facts.text: The image is a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet: a large hero image at the top, a three-view turnaround row in the middle, and four detail crops along the bottom.

The top hero panel shows the character standing upright on a rain-slicked rooftop or elevated walkway at night, body facing forward and head turned toward the viewer's left; metal railings border the walkway and warm lights glow on a dark building at right.
The character has dark hair with closely shaved sides and the remaining hair gathered into a small top-knot at the crown, visible in the hero, profile, back, and face views.
The character wears a nearly all-black outfit: a collared utility jacket with shoulder straps and buckle hardware, a black crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.

The middle row presents three full-body turnaround views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK against a dark gray, near-black backdrop; the front view faces camera with arms at the sides, the profile faces left, and the back view faces away.

The FACE detail crop is a tight close-up of the same character with a neutral expression, showing a thin diagonal scar or mark through one eyebrow and a faint dark marking above the brow that is too small to read.
The JACKET COLLAR detail crop shows the jacket's dark fabric, high collar, and stitched strap-and-buckle construction.
The HANDS detail crop shows two relaxed hands viewed from the backs, with visible veins and knuckles.
The BOOTS detail crop shows a pair of black lace-up combat boots with scuffed, worn leather and thick soles.
Visible panel labels in uppercase read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

Lighting is low-key and cinematic: the hero panel mixes cool blue rainy-night tones with warm amber practical lights and wet reflections, while the turnaround and detail panels use soft neutral studio illumination against dark gray backgrounds.
The palette is dominated by black and charcoal, with muted skin tones, cool blue night highlights, and sparse warm amber accents.

card.summary: Vertical photorealistic character reference sheet for a dark tactical-dressed adult, with a rainy-night hero shot, front/side/back turnaround, and face, jacket collar, hands, and boots detail crops.

subjects.descriptor: Central adult character shown consistently across all panels
attributes: Dark hair with shaved sides and a small top-knot
Thin diagonal scar or mark through one eyebrow and a faint dark marking above the brow
Black collared utility jacket with shoulder straps and buckles
pose: Hero panel: standing with body facing front and head turned to the viewer's left
FRONT panel: standing facing camera with arms at the sides
SIDE PROFILE panel: standing in profile facing left
BACK panel: standing facing away from camera

card.environment: Hero panel: rainy nighttime urban rooftop or elevated walkway with wet reflective ground, metal railings, and a dark building with warm lights; turnaround and detail panels: dark gray studio-like backdrop.
card.lighting: Low-key cinematic lighting; the hero panel uses cool blue rainy-night tones with warm amber practical lights, while the turnaround and detail panels use soft neutral studio illumination against near-black backgrounds.
card.framing: Vertical composite reference sheet: one wide full-body hero image at top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle row, and four detail crops along the bottom.
card.style: Photorealistic cinematic character-design reference sheet with a gritty, low-light tactical aesthetic.
card.characterisation: A single character identity presented through a hero shot, turnaround views, and close-up detail studies.

limitations: The small dark marking above one eyebrow and any clothing insignia are too small or illegible to transcribe.
The near-black wardrobe compresses fine material and color differences, so exact fabric types are not fully determinable.
As a single still reference sheet, the image cannot establish motion, camera movement, sound, or dialogue.
